title: Ctrl-K search: add Conversations to the type list
body:
## Problem

The Ctrl-K type list includes Actions, Workspaces, and Issues, but Conversations are missing even though conversation results are searchable. Operators cannot explicitly narrow the palette to conversations.

## Requested behavior

Add Conversations as a first-class entry in the Ctrl-K type list, following the same interaction and visual conventions as Actions, Workspaces, and Issues.

## Acceptance criteria

- The Ctrl-K type list includes Conversations alongside Actions, Workspaces, and Issues.
- Selecting Conversations limits results to conversation entries.
- The Conversations entry supports the same keyboard navigation, selection, active-state, and clear/reset behavior as existing types.
- Empty, loading, and error states are correct when the Conversations type is selected.
- Tests cover selecting Conversations, filtering results, clearing the type, and keyboard navigation.
- Conversation ordering composes correctly with #3703 and the toggle requested in #3704.
